Find the commit that broke a flow, changed a screen or made a test fail.

```sh
proof bisect [--json] [--flow <flow>] [--snap <snap>] [--test <test>] [--good <good>] [--bad <bad>] [--verbose]
```

A binary search between --good (default: where this branch left its base) and --bad (default: HEAD).
Each commit is built in the stack worktree; your checkout and git's own bisect are untouched.
Commits that don't build are skipped.
```text
proof bisect --flow onboarding                  first commit where the flow fails
proof bisect --flow home --snap home            first commit where the home screen's tree changed
proof bisect --test TimerTests/testPresets      first commit where the test fails
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--flow <flow>` | Flow to replay on each commit. |
| `--snap <snap>` | With --flow: look for the first commit where this snap's tree differs from the good commit's. |
| `--test <test>` | Test identifier (Target/Class/test) to run on each commit. |
| `--good <good>` | A commit or branch where things were right. |
| `--bad <bad>` | A commit or branch where they're wrong (default HEAD). |
| `--verbose` | Stream raw xcodebuild output to stderr. |
